name: Router::rank_files

test_list.description: Only the configured lexical shortlist is submitted to S1.
An S1 outage returns deterministic lexical fallback scores.
Ties are path ordered and duplicate or oversized paths are rejected.

inputs.name: files
inputs.description: Caller-generated paths, excerpts, and lexical scores.

output_description: A deterministic, bounded ranking of unique paths supplied by the caller.
